changelog:
A proper audio scrubber for relistening to meetings.

Drag the bar to jump anywhere, skip back 15 seconds or forward 30, and speed playback up to 2x. Tap the time next to one of your notes or a transcript line to play from that moment.

A recording that's still on your phone now plays right there, offline - no desktop needed.

Includes 0.0.111: type your own notes into a meeting while it records.
